scoring_justification: P_r is recomputed from fitted_parameters.csv; monotonicity and sign are checked; crossover pressure is recomputed from the P_r curve and compared to paper gold (2.3 kbar); fitted_parameters is audited for completeness.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold for crossover pressure at 300 K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: 'The value of P_r becomes negative at pressures above 2.3 kbar. This point marks the crossover between the prevalence of tetrahedral and hexagonal structures.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the published article (Section 3, Fig. 3 description).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: directly quoted from the paper with explicit numeric value.

outputs.description: All fitted G-function parameters for each pressure. Checker recomputes P_r from these parameters and scores against hidden gold P_r values from the paper.
Order parameter P_r at each pressure. Checker compares the reported P_r values directly to hidden paper gold values (from Fig. 3) with tolerance, and enforces monotonic decrease.
Pressure where P_r=0 (crossover from tetrahedral to hexagonal dominance). Checker compares to paper-reported value within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The task covers only the 300 K pressure sweep using SPC/E water; the temperature-dependent curve and argon reference are omitted per scope. The checker recomputes P_r from fitted_parameters.csv as a consistency check and compares pr_vs_pressure.csv and crossover_pressure.txt to hidden gold derived from the paper's Fig. 3. All scored artifacts must be present; missing files score zero.
